name: knowledgemaxxing
tagline: Every rabbit hole you ever went down, searchable — a local-first AI knowledge base of your whole digital life
description: knowledgemaxxing is a local-first, AI-powered knowledge base that makes your entire digital life searchable — every rabbit hole, every saved tab, every note, everything. It indexes your personal data and layers AI retrieval on top so you can actually find what you half-remembered. The project is Python-based and designed to run on your own machine, keeping your data local.
highlights: Searchable index across your whole digital life
Local-first design keeps personal data on your machine
AI-powered retrieval for fuzzy 'I half-remember this' queries
Early project (1 star) but a sharp, well-scoped idea
curatorNote: 'Every rabbit hole you ever went down, searchable' is the most honest description of personal knowledge management I have read this year. Local-first and AI-powered — watch this one.
